content:
The **Helvetia Community Center** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

Located on the southeastern end of town, the Community Center is a small, two-story tall building. The main entrance is located on the northern end and leads into a small reception area. Behind the counter is a level 3-locked Floor Safe. Further to the south are a set of stairs leading to the second floor, a bathroom on the eastern side, an office on the western side, and an exhibit room on the southern side.

On the second floor is a large sitting area with several tables and chairs. A door frame in the northeastern corner leads into a small kitchen, which has two skeletons, a Duffle Bag and a Chem Box.

The Helvetia Community Center appears in *Fallout 76*.
